item.title: Of Brother Wars and Online Controversies [Rebel - Podcast for Cultural Engagement]
item.description:
This week P Nate and Pootie look in the rear view mirror to discuss the recent online kerfuffle regarding declarations, anon accounts and neo-nazis.

Ultimately the Rebels weigh in with more of a discussion on how Christians should handle themselves online and how we approach controversy in general.

item.title: We Are So Back! [Rebel - Podcast for Cultural Engagement]
item.description: After our last big series “How to Win the World” the Rebels, in the middle of moving to a new church building, took some much needed down time… but now we are so back and a lot has happened in the downtime: Donald Trump has been elected so we take the time to discuss what that means for all faithful Christians working to build Christendom 2.0. Reformed Brothers continue to squabble online. The wokeys keep fighting a losing battle… in this episode P Nate and Pootie weigh in on all that’s going on.
